question: Google Drive, Sky Drive and Dropbox are perfect examples of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**cloud storage services**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Google Drive, Sky Drive, and Dropbox** are prime examples of **cloud storage services.**
 
• These services allow users to store data on remote servers accessed from the internet, enabling them to retrieve their data from any location using any device with internet connectivity.
 
• **Cloud storage services** provide benefits such as data backup, file sharing, and synchronization across multiple devices.
 
• They are part of the broader concept of **cloud computing,** which includes services like cloud storage, cloud hosting, and cloud software.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cloud storage** is different from traditional storage solutions as it does not require physical hardware like external hard drives or USB drives.
 
• It offers scalable storage solutions where users can increase or decrease their storage capacity based on their needs.
 
• Some popular cloud storage services other than Google Drive, Sky Drive (now OneDrive), and Dropbox include iCloud, Amazon S3, and Box.
 
• Cloud storage services often come with additional security features such as encryption, access control, and secure data transfer to protect user data.
